description: Charge the throttle, hit the electrified UFO ramp and launch Chris into the dusk sky for distance. Bounce off wrecks, grab moonboots and stay ahead of the graveyard skeletons and the UFO lasers for as long as you can. Every run ends one of four ways: lasered, boned, crashed, or wheels down.
